messages:
Alex W: heads up — found a permissive fallback in per-route permission checks after yesterday's RBAC refactor. embeddings route accepted a chat-scoped token and returned 200. this looks like a policy fallthrough not matching per-route scopes. :rotating_light:
Maria G: can you paste repro steps? and which deploy?
Alex W: curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-chat-xxxx' \ 
  -d '{"input":"foo"}'
```
response 200 with embedding payload. logs show policy evaluation: `route=/_embeddings`, `token_scope=chat:generate`, `route_policy=scopes: [embeddings:vector]` -> decision=ALLOW (fallback=global_scopes).
Jamal H: ugh. i remember we changed the matcher to fall back to global scopes when route-level scopes missing. that was intended for legacy routes but shouldnt apply when route has explicit scopes. maybe a nil-check bug. :eyes:
Maria G: which deploy id?
Alex W: deploy id rb-2026-03-18-17:05 (rbac-service). pushed yesterday.
SRE Bot: incident suggested severity=P2 until rollback or patch; create INC-2026-789. logging: capture all tokens used against /v1/embeddings in the last 24h.
Security Bot: checklist:
- rotate any keys that might have been used for unauthorized embeddings calls
- snapshot audit logs (KMS metadata + token id)
- block service account if suspicious
- add retrospective note to compliance audit
DevX Eng: add reproduction unit test and e2e for scope enforcement per-route. don't rely on global fallback.
Jamal H: quick triage patch idea: make policy matcher treat missing per-route scopes as DENY rather than fallthrough; also add explicit allowlist for legacy endpoints via feature flag. short diff:
```
- if route_scopes == nil then use global_scopes
+ if route_scopes == nil then deny by default
+ legacy_allowlist: ["/v1/health", "/v1/status"] (feature-flagged)
```
Alex W: sounds good. mitigation steps I ran locally: 1) deploy patch to canary (us-west-2, 10% traffic) 2) smoke test embeddings with chat token -> 403 3) run audit query to list successful calls by token id.
Maria G: KMS/rotation question — do we rotate all API keys or only keys that show embeddings calls? rotating all is heavy for customers.
Security Bot: rotate keys that show exploit usage. for broader risk, recommend rolling rotation window for keys created before rb-2026-03-18. add short TTL to newly issued tokens. log rotation actions to KMS audit.
SRE Bot: rolling rollback option: revert rb-2026-03-18 deploy if patch will take too long; but rollback reduces other RBAC fixes. prefer targeted patch and canary.
DevX Eng: i'll add unit tests on matcher and an integration test that asserts `chat:*` tokens get 403 on embeddings. also add CI gate for any future RBAC changes.
Jamal H: pushed hotfix branch fix/rbac-enforce-deny; PR 4521. CI green. deploying canary now.
Alex W: canary results: embeddings with chat token -> 403, embeddings with embeddings-scoped token -> 200, no other regressions on health checks. audit query shows 8 unique chat tokens used against embeddings in last 6h. created rotation list.
Security Bot: please mark affected keys and notify account owners for rotation. add the set to INC-2026-789.
Maria G: also add note for customers using composite keys (org-level) — they might need to reissue per-route scoped keys. coordinate with sales/CS.
DevX Eng: long-term: change default_action to DENY in policy schema and require explicit allow for every route. add lint to policy yamls that fails CI if default_action != deny.
Alex W: agreed. created a follow-up RFC ticket RFC-2026-22 for policy defaults + audit/backfill plan.
Jamal H: after patch rollout to 100%, will run a KMS rotation script for flagged keys and publish a changelog entry.
Alex W: thanks all. action items recap:
- Jamal: finish rollout + KMS rotation list (ETA 3h)
- DevX Eng: tests + CI gates (ETA EOD)
- Maria: customer comms + CS handoff (ETA EOD)
- Security Bot: update incident and compliance notes
Status: mitigation deployed to prod canary, rollback not needed. continuing rotation and audits. :white_check_mark:
